Khi gửi hàng hoá và gửi yêu cầu giao hàn.en: When you send the goods and send the demand for delivery to the transport unit, complete the procedures, you will be given a confirmation receipt for the delivery service deal, or the delivery agreement with the major order. In this paper, there'll be a single-code attached to that cargo.
Khi gửi hàng hoá và gửi yêu cầu giao hàn.zh: 发货后向运输单位发送送货要求,办理完手续后,发给送货服务交易确认收据,或者与主要订单的送货协议. 在这张报纸上,会有一个单码 附加在货物。

Khi tra cứu vận đơn đường biển bạn sẽ th.en: As you look into the marine transport order, you'll see the date of the time when your freight ship comes from the harbour, the whole time moored at the shipping ports (if any), the information on the singles, the name of your freight ship... can appear entirely by the shipping units. But in general, the most basic information will be shown so that the customer may have information, and control his freight schedule.
Khi tra cứu vận đơn đường biển bạn sẽ th.zh: 检查海洋运输订单时,可以看到货运船从港口来的日期,整个时间停泊在通航港口(如果有的话),单船信息,货运船名......可以完全由通航单位显示. 但总的来说,最基本的信息将会被显示,以便客户可能掌握信息,并控制其货运时间表.

Khi tra cứu vận đơn đường biển, cả chủ h.en: As we look into the sea line mail, both the owner and the management unit will be aware of the cargo status. Unfortunately, there's a bad situation like the wrong order, the wrong address, the clients that can't accept the goods... the owners and transport units will be in time. There will be the best solutions, avoid other jobs that arise and cost more and more time and may affect the quality of the cargo to be delivered.
Khi tra cứu vận đơn đường biển, cả chủ h.zh: 在我们查看海线邮件时,车主和管理单位都会了解货物状况. 不幸的是,有糟糕的情况,比如错误的订单,错误的地址,无法接受商品的客户... 业主和运输单位会及时到来. 将会有最佳的解决办法,避免出现其他工作,这些工作需要越来越多的时间,并可能影响待发货物的质量。

Quá trình vận chuyển hàng hóa bằng đường.en: The shipping process by sea requires proper procedure with complete paperwork. The goods that are transported by sea often have long distances, moving from one continent to another. Among these requirements for shipping procedures, it is important and necessary for all sea traffic operations. To help you better understand the role of a sea line search as well as how to look into a single line in a fast and accurate way, Liu Media shares details through the following article.
Quá trình vận chuyển hàng hóa bằng đường.zh: 海运过程需要经过适当的程序并提交完整的文件。 海上运输的货物往往有很长的距离,从一个大陆转移到另一个大陆。 在这些关于航运程序的要求中,对所有海上交通业务都很重要和必要。 为了帮助你更好地理解海线搜索的作用,以及如何以快速准确的方式对单线进行搜索,刘传媒通过以下文章分享细节.

Tra cứu vận đơn đường biển là gì?.en: What is a sea route search?

Tra cứu vận đơn đường biển là một hoạt đ.en: Surveying sea-way units is an operation necessary to locate the condition of the order. Each package was transported by sea, as any intermediate unit also had a single-code or single-coded code. It's like sending the goods through the post office, the single code is attached to each package, including the delivery date information, the deposit site, the delivery point, the single...
Tra cứu vận đơn đường biển là một hoạt đ.zh: 勘测海路单位是确定订单状况所必需的作业. 每个包裹都是通过海上运输的,因为任何中间单元也有单码或单码编码. 这就像通过邮局发送货物,单码被附在每包上,包括交货日期信息,存款站点,交货点,单...

Trước đây thông tin này khách hàng sẽ kh.en: Previously this information was not to be controlled by the customer, the new transport unit could look into the state of the cargo according to this single code.
Trước đây thông tin này khách hàng sẽ kh.zh: 以前这种信息不应由客户控制,新的运输单位可以按照这个单一代码调查货物的状况。

Trước đây, nếu muốn tra cứu vận đơn đườn.en: Formerly, if you want to look into the marine transport, the goods owner needs to directly contact the unit he chooses the shipping service. This unit will look into the system and report the exact situation to the owner. But right now, the technology system develops, the units have applied to provide the customer support platform that actively examines his application.
Trước đây, nếu muốn tra cứu vận đơn đườn.zh: 以前,如果想查询海运情况,货主需要直接联系其所选择的航运服务单位. 该股将调查系统并向业主报告确切情况。 但是,现在,技术系统发展,这些单位已经申请提供客户支持平台,积极检查他的应用.
